description: Search PUBLIC Threads posts for a keyword or topic: competitor listening, what people say about a product, real customer language for ad copy. Each post carries Meta’s is_reply, has_replies, is_quote_post and media_type. ExcludeReplies:true drops replies from Meta’s page (Threads has no reply filter), so a result can be shorter than limit; repliesExcluded counts them. TOP ranks by popularity WITHIN a time window, and with no `until` that window is about the last day. For a longer stretch set `until` to a past date (since 2026-10-01 + until 2026-10-31 reads that month). Each search returns a few dozen posts whatever `limit` says, with no paging, so cover a long period with several windows. Other accounts’ posts carry no like, reply or view counts.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

authorUsername.description: only posts by this Threads account (exact username, no @) — 'what has @competitor said about X'

mediaType.description: TEXT, IMAGE or VIDEO — only that kind of post

searchMode.description: KEYWORD (default) or TAG — TAG searches a TOPIC TAG (what is being said under #skincare)

searchType.description: TOP (default, most popular) or RECENT (newest first)

since.description: only posts on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO or unix seconds; Threads search reaches back to 2023-07-05)

until.description: only posts on/before this date; a past date moves the TOP window back

name: search_threads_keyword
title: Search Threads by keyword
